reference: official VinDr-CXR train reader votes; three independent rad_ID labels
model_conditional: llava only after 128/128 token-exact common-protocol identity

power_rule.rationale: resolve the preregistered 0.05 boundary with a two-sided 95% interval no wider than 0.10

probe_contract: same capacity, regularization and optimization for every layer; layer selected on dev only

states.early_erasure: early-final AUROC >= 0.05, CI_low > 0, and bidirectional same-polarity activation patch passes
states.layer_stable: the complete early-final 95% CI lies within [-0.05, 0.05]
states.not_decodable: powered test, all preregistered controls present, and neither early nor final exceeds the dev-selected strongest control (both increment CI_high <= 0)
states.indeterminate: none of the preregistered positive, equivalence, or powered-null criteria pass

method_trigger: only early_erasure in both directions for a strict majority of qualified findings on both primary models
